read.thesis: Jabil raised FY26 revenue to about $34B and core EPS to $12.25 on AI-driven demand, but held core margin at 5.7%, citing conservatism; supply constraints in memory and PCBs are tightening.

capex.peers_comment: Management referred to peers announcing significant capex increases but did not comment on their capacity.
capex.quote: we feel comfortable on how we're modeling 1.5% to 2% going forward on CapEx to revenue.

triggers.label: Utilisation 75% → 80%
triggers.quote: I think last year, we're at 75%. Today, we're coming in at 80%.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue raised ~$1.6B to ~$34B
triggers.quote: we now expect revenues of approximately $34 billion, an increase of approximately $1.6 billion from a prior outlook of $32.4 billion.

triggers.label: Core margin held at 5.7% despite upside
triggers.quote: I feel really good about the 5% right now, the 5.7% for the year in FY '26.

triggers.label: Memory and PCB supply tightening
triggers.quote: They're getting a little bit tighter.

triggers.label: AI-related revenue up 46% to $13.1B
triggers.quote: we now expect AI-related revenue to grow approximately 46% year-over-year to $13.1 billion in fiscal 2026.

guidance.quote: we now expect revenues of approximately $34 billion
We're also raising our full year diluted earnings per share outlook to $12.25, up from $11.55.
For the full year, we continue to expect core operating margins of approximately 5.7%.
we still expect adjusted free cash flow of more than $1.3 billion.
we're further increasing our fiscal 2026 AI-related revenue outlook by approximately $1 billion compared to December
overall for the year, it will be around 1% of revenue.
total company revenue for Q3 is expected to be in the range of $8.1 billion to $8.9 billion.
I think we have a really high level of confidence in that 6% for FY '27.
I expect some level of closure within the next few weeks, that will be a major contributor for FY '27 as well.

red_flags.label: Core margin guide not raised despite revenue upside
red_flags.quote: we want to be a little bit more conservative given everything that's going on in the world with the geopolitics and the uncertainties out there.

red_flags.label: Memory and PCB shortages tightening
red_flags.quote: supply chain constraints, they are definitely there. They're getting a little bit tighter.

evasions.quote: Could it be higher? Sure. I just feel a little sort of -- we want to be a little bit more conservative
